Sausage Ramen Hotpot
guilty indulgence | rainy day delights 

Nutrition:

Ingredients 
1/2 tsp chilli oil 
150 grams chicken sausage 
1 onion, finely sliced 1/2 green capsicum, sliced 
1 packet instant ramen as per your preference, i used samyang 2X noodles
handful of chopped coriander
